verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Copilot Automations run the cloud agent automatically on a schedule or in response to repository events. That is a recurring scheduled job, not a one-off action, so the core story is met. However, both mentions are single-sentence claims without configuration detail. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on schedule syntax, frequency options and job management, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled automations work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automations let you run Copilot cloud agent automatically, on a schedule or in response to events in a repository.
Set up an automation to run Copilot automatically, on a schedule or in response to events such as an issue being opened.
